sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Resume the 169 rate-limited or timed-out pages in the 17-role-family by four-location past-24-hour matrix, starting with Business Analyst in Delhi at start 0; preserve all individual failures as incomplete and retry after cooldown
sourceLanes.notes: The three saved checkpoints were recovered successfully first. The afternoon 207-page past-24-hour sweep then completed only 38 requests; 169 pages were blocked by LinkedIn HTTP 429 responses or timeouts and remain incomplete. Direct verification produced one new role: Arrow Electronics Business Intelligence Analyst in Gurugram, posted within two days, live Apply, entry-level label, strong Power BI/reporting/automation fit, and a two-year experience hurdle. Hero FinCorp, Trinity Life Sciences, and Rockwell Automation candidates were excluded for six-to-nine, two-to-four, and two-to-five year requirements. The active-link audit initially surfaced eazyway and SmartQ through false-positive text matching, but fresh direct pages showed live Apply controls; both correctly remain active.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh employee, recruiter, founder, and company posts using reporting, MIS, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, Python, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Fresh normal hiring-post searches were run independently from LinkedIn Jobs across data, BI, MIS, risk, operations, SQL, Python, Power BI, fresher, graduate, intern, referral, recruiter, and founder variants. Results were older repost farms, undated comment-to-DM posts, or previously known roles; no post-only opportunity passed the current-original-post and usable-route gates.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then canonicalize the newly added LinkedIn roles where exact employer requisitions appear
sourceLanes.notes: Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday, and company-career variants were refreshed independently. Current Paytm, Portcast, Aspora, and other results were already active, previously excluded for experience, or outside the freshness and early-career gates. No additional canonical employer requisition passed the exact-role verification gate.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Authenticated Instahyre traversal, deeper Cutshort pagination, current YC company boards, accelerator portfolio boards, and state-reversal checks for excluded Wellfound IDs
sourceLanes.notes: Wellfound, Cutshort, YC Work at a Startup, and startup-board variants were refreshed independently. Fragma remained live and already active. Emergent Labs had a live button but was posted one year ago, and fintoric capital was reposted outside the 30-day freshness window; both were excluded from the active board. FOXO remains excluded pending a confirmed state reversal, and Instahyre remains authentication-gated.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals

sourceLanes.notes: Internshala, Unstop, and Hirist variants were refreshed. Internshala direct detail remained robots-blocked; Hirist results were stale or senior, and no current specialist role passed the direct-page, freshness, and early-career gates.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals

Naukri direct detail remained robots-blocked, current search results were stale or senior, and no broad-portal discovery could be canonicalized to a fresh verified employer destination. No broad-portal role passed publication.
